Release sweep v18.5.0, round 2 (release sha), record R2-P0: the standing P0 smoke on the Version Packages merge. Dispatched by qa#3 (seat #33014), wave anchor #33761, round 1 P0 record #33784 (a557fa38, 22 PASS / 2 PARTIAL). **No P0 FAIL, no regression versus round 1 or 18.4.0; the two partials are the same standing dependency gaps as every earlier round.**

## Environment fingerprint

- framework objectstack-ai/objectstack **b914e7247f69** (`chore: version packages (#33097)`, v18.5.0); `ui/` in the same tree.
- **Versions read:** `GET /api/v1/health` → `18.5.0`; discovery → `18.5.0`; `objectstack --version` → `@objectstack/cli/18.5.0`.
- **Console:** built in the same tree (`pnpm console:build`, 12:42–13:00Z, "dist ready (86876 KB)"); the served entry chunk `assets/index-CnbKsN6g.js` is byte-identical to `packages/console/dist` (sha256 `7f6fd756…13f0`), so no stale-bundle trap.
- Build: install + `OS_SKIP_DTS=1 turbo build` of showcase / CLI / dogfood closures (70 packages, 1 m 20 s) + spec with dts. Node 22.23.4, pnpm 10.31.0, 4 CPUs, 15 GiB memory cgroup. Playwright with the preinstalled chromium.
- App: stock showcase, `objectstack dev --seed-admin --no-compile --no-watch` on its own `OS_PORT` and file DB per item (ports 41174–41191); walled `isolated` / `group` boots by hand with the posture env vars; Postgres via `qa-fixture.mjs external-database` (PG16, torn down); contributor persona via `qa-fixture.mjs contributor-member`; every compile / migrate / deploy / `verify --rls` / external-datasource leg in a scratch app copy. The tree's showcase dist (mtime 12:40) and installed-packages untouched; no `e2e/.auth` left in the tree.
- Execution: **parallel**, 2 runner subagents (opus, effort `high`): P0A (16 api / cli items) and P0B (8 browser / mixed items), alongside the R2-API slice runners (≤3 at a time).
- Wall-clock: shared setup 6 min (12:39–12:45Z; console build to 13:00Z) · P0A tests 12:46–13:29Z · P0B tests 13:14–13:58Z · assembly 10 min.

## Scope

`priority:P0` at b914e724 → 24 runnable items; every revision matched the area JSON and round 1 (none moved). No `planned` item. Pins: objectql 4 files / 251, plugin-security 3 / 32, rest 2 / 22, runtime 7 / 121, plugin-auth 1 / 57, mcp 2 / 27, cli 8 / 190, dogfood 18 files (P0A); `showcase-smoke.spec.ts` 50 passed (browser e2e against a live boot, P0B); **0 failed** (one dogfood file OOM-killed in a batch, re-run alone 8/8). Clause totals: **218 pass · 0 fail · 2 blocked · 0 skipped**. The `ui/e2e/live/studio-object-designer.spec.ts` F1 pin named by `studio-authoring.first-run-loop` acc[0] was not run; that clause was driven by hand in the browser on both the en and zh-CN legs.

## Commits since round 1 that meet P0 surfaces

- #33755 (Setup → Users Add / Import on a managed environment): on the unmanaged stock boot Setup → Users draws "Import" and "Invite User" and renders normally; `sys-user.object.ts` changed, and the crud matrix's delegate × sys_user cells were re-driven (96/96 live withheld cells refused). The managed-environment branch is not reachable from a stock boot.
- #33780 (related list keyed by a parent lookup): the showcase_account record page rendered fully on every visit; its related lists do not exercise the parent-lookup case.
- #33746 (AI model picker cost multiplier): no P0 item reaches the picker.

## Parked-on #33761 (checklist accuracy, fixture gaps)

- `platform-core.seed-integrity` steps[1] still gives the baseline as invoice_line=7 / 138 rows; at b914e724 it is 10 / 141 (re-derived as the step says). Repeats round 1.
- `api-backend.query-contract-matrix` acc[8] names no variant count; this run drove 22 operator variants in both spellings plus 8 params (30/30, 0 skipped). Worth stating the count.
- `platform-core.v18-boot-refusals` acc[1] names `os dev` as a boot whose refusal carries `--dev`; `os dev` catches the refusal and upgrades in place with a backup, and only `os serve --dev` prints the operator-facing `--dev` text. Repeats round 1.
- `cli.organization-ownership-ceremony` acc[5] "count after = count before less what moved" does not allow this release's seed additions on the second boot (invoice_line 5→10, sys_user_position 5→10, sys_metadata_activation 0→1, sys_migration 4→6, sys_oauth_resource 1→2); the drops matched the apply report exactly (sys_email 4→2, sys_setting_audit 9→1, sys_webhook 1→0). Suggested wording: "no row disappears except as the report moves / deletes it".
- `cli-18-prerelease-db` recipe: the restore does not re-date the reset token, so step 3 (UPDATE sys_verification) runs by hand; knownGaps[4] is stale (the activity shard re-dates to `sys_activity__r20261114`).
- `platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render`: the marketplace catalog proxy answers 502 in this environment (knownGap); the page shows its named "Failed to load marketplace" state, scored as rendering honestly.
- `approvals.account-app-entry` acc[6] / first-run-loop zh leg: the avatar-menu Language control is a `button` named "Language" in the Preferences row, not a `menuitem` — a role-targeted driver must look for the button.
- `integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix`: a minimal scratch project needs `sharingModel` declared or `security-owd-unset` refuses it before the credential check (fixture note).
- `access-security.no-active-org-session-semantics` knownGaps[3] (#32111, NULL tenant_id on audit rows): recorded, not scored.
- Runner trap: `os dev` silently takes the next free port when `-p` is taken; a restart issued while the old server still listens boots a second server on +1 against the same DB. Check the port with lsof (no `ss` in the container).

## Off-clause probes (RUNNER rule 8)

About 74 min over the 24 items (P0A ≈ 51, P0B ≈ 23), same boots and personas (admin, auditor, liaison, contributor, guest, group P1 / P2 members, anonymous, browser contexts). Classes: empty / unknown / blank ids, case and package-id spellings, wrong verbs, string booleans, out-of-range limits and ports, forged owner / actorId / organization, projection / history / search doors as secret-confirmation channels, walled postures. No product defect found. Observations below the filing bar: `GET /api/v1/health/` (trailing slash) → 404; an unknown viewName on an object list silently falls back to "All Records"; `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/NEW?mode=draft&package=` with an **empty** package value is accepted as an env-wide draft while a missing or unknown package is refused (admin, new name, draft only — same blank-`package=` pattern as R2-API's `/meta/view?package=` note); a member reading `/api/settings/UNKNOWN` gets 404 UNKNOWN_NAMESPACE while a real namespace answers 403 (namespace ids are public manifest ids).

No cards extracted from this record.
